meta.title: White County — the money trail
meta.note: This is White County's 2026 annual operating budget as filed with the state: an appropriation ordinance for calendar year 2026 and the detailed budget behind it, scanned. We use the ordinance amount for each fund and office, and the detail pages for the categories. Three funds move money to other county funds ($5,946,000.00 from the General Reserve Fund, $680,730.00 from Other County Expenses and $39,886.00 from the Sheriff's law enforcement tax), so those $6,666,616.00 appear in both the fund that sends them and the fund that spends them.

nodes.name: Tax Assessor
nodes.note: The ordinance (p. 1) and the General Fund summary (p. 78) print $1,749,469.57. The Assessor's detail pages print a total of $1,741,384.41 (p. 26), and the categories add to that.
